title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘reiterates its call on the Commission to step up its efforts to engage with the Turkish Cypriot community, with a view to facilitating the resolution of the Cyprus problem and recalling that its place is in the European Union; calls for all parties involved to demonstrate a more courageous approach to bringing the communities together;’
